753:t_179:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's right! You've forgotten what love feels like! You could never understand our dreams and hopes!」

753:t_179:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I have... forgotten love...?」

753:t_179:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「The proof is that you can't understand the power dwelling in my wings!」

753:t_179:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「Here I come, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! My wings will soar beyond the fate you decree!」

753:t_179:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll fight you to protect the ones I love!!」

753:t_180:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, follow me! We'll defeat him and end it all!」

753:t_180:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You have admirable spirit, $$オズマ$$. But it is already too late for everything.」

753:t_180:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「In my embrace, you will face the universe's end...」

753:t_180:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I don't have time to listen to your bullshit!」

753:t_180:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Brace yourself, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll defeat you to protect the world where I live with the woman I love!!」

753:t_181:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ミシェル$$... You can reunite with your sister in the new world.」

753:t_181:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「If you think you're being kind, then God's got a pretty warped perspective!」

753:t_181:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「The past is the past! I've been looking toward the future for a long time!」

753:t_181:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am the one who creates that future. Your bodies will perish along with this world!」

753:t_181:4.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「That's enough, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll shoot through that glib tongue of yours!!」

753:t_181:5.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I've spotted the future beyond my targeting sight! I'll snipe my target too!!」

753:t_182:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ルカ$$... Share my data with everyone. Then they will be able to give up.」

753:t_182:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「It won't go the way you think. In fact, I have no intention of retreating myself.」

753:t_182:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「We won't just do nothing and accept the result...! Whether we face God or the universe, we'll resist with all our strength to the very end!」

753:t_182:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am surprised. A gentle boy like you harbors such fighting spirit.」

753:t_182:4.en:
$$ルカ$$
「I have someone I want to protect too! I'll fight for that person!」

753:t_182:5.en:
$$ルカ$$
「$$ナナセ$$! I'll risk this life to protect you!」

753:t_183:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「$$ミシェル$$! I'll seize the future with you by defeating this monster!」

753:t_183:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then, $$クラン$$... Shall I use my power to send just you and $$ミシェル$$ to the next universe?」

753:t_183:2.en:
$$クラン$$
「Shut up, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You try to deceive and corrupt people with those words! You're a devil, not God!」

753:t_183:3.en:
$$クラン$$
「Don't underestimate a $$ゼントラン$$! I don't need a future handed to me out of charity!」

753:t_183:4.en:
$$クラン$$
「The future must be won, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll fight you with every battle instinct carved into my genes!!」

753:t_184:0.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Wait for me, $$エディ$$! Mom will protect you and the universe!」

753:t_184:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「A mother is strong... I feel your boundless love, $$カナリア$$.」

753:t_184:2.en:
$$カナリア$$
「You wouldn't understand how it feels to fight for what you want to protect!」

753:t_184:3.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Disappear, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You love no one, so you're unworthy of God's name!!」

753:t_185:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are reckless, $$ブレラ$$. Do you intend to throw your life away?」

753:t_185:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I made my peace with that long ago, to protect $$ランカ$$... and the world she loves!」

753:t_185:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Unconditional love is what I bestow as God.」

753:t_185:3.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Don't give me that...! You accept the universe's destruction! You don't love anyone!」

753:t_185:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The only thing you love is your own existence! We won't hand our world to a man like that!!」

753:t_186:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ガムリン$$... If your love were unrequited, could you endure that fact?」

753:t_186:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Don't make me laugh, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You think those words will shake me!?」

753:t_186:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then can you answer my question?」

753:t_186:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If you want to hear it that badly, I'll tell you!」

753:t_186:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Love asks for nothing in return! If you can't understand that, you have no right to call yourself God!」

753:t_186:6.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Let's do this, $$ミレーヌ$$! I'll protect my future with you... and $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$'s songs!!」

753:t_187:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! The universe's biggest concert is starting!!」

753:t_187:1.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「W-wait, $$バサラ$$! I'm sure he doesn't want to listen to any songs!」

753:t_187:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「He used to be human too! He's gotta have a heart!」

753:t_187:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But my heart will not be moved. God must be absolute.」

753:t_187:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Is that cramped way of living any fun!? Throw away your duties and responsibilities and try following your heart!」

753:t_187:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I should follow my heart...」

753:t_187:6.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Did $$バサラ$$'s words reach him...?」

753:t_187:7.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「We've got to give this a shot.」

753:t_187:11.en:
$$バサラ$$
「The universe, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, everything! Listen to my song!!」

753:t_187:12.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Burn with the flame of life!! Everyone, siiiing!!」

753:t_188:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Separated from your flock, you have been tormented by anxiety... It must have been painful, $$レド$$.」

753:t_188:1.en:
$$レド$$
「People who become unable to decide for themselves that way cling to a stronger power...」

753:t_188:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#robot$$ called that system 'God'.」

753:t_188:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Yes. I am now that ultimate being.」

753:t_188:4.en:
$$レド$$
「That means you're just like $$ストライカー#robot$$: a being humans don't need to live as humans...!」

753:t_188:5.en:
$$レド$$
「No...! You're a being we must defeat in order to live!」

753:t_188:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But you will learn just how reckless your attempt is.」

753:t_188:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And you will regret it! You will wish you had spent your little remaining time in peace!」

753:t_188:8.en:
$$レド$$
「I have no intention of feeling that way!」

753:t_188:10.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's do this, $$チェインバー#robot$$! This is our final battle!」

753:t_188:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. This unit's mission is to become one with Ensign $$レド$$ and conclude the final battle in victory.」

753:t_188:12.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm human, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! By defeating you, I'll prove...」

753:t_188:13.en:
$$レド$$
「...that humans can live without clinging to any god!!」

753:t_189:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I'll beat down an obnoxious man calling himself God, out in the sea of stars...」

753:t_189:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Wouldn't that feel rather good?」

753:t_189:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your swagger ends here, $$ラケージ$$. Your words are unpleasant.」

753:t_189:3.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Of course. I'm provoking you.」

753:t_189:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You do not fear God... You are beyond saving!」

753:t_189:5.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「You're much more charming when you show your emotions like that, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll crush you as a reward!」

753:t_190:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you want to start your life over too, $$宗介$$?」

753:t_190:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There is nothing to worry about. In the new world I guide, you and $$かなめ$$ will receive new lives. I shall reunite you.」

753:t_190:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of asking a man like you to play Cupid!」

kept_omissions: 753:t_180:2: Advent begins promising to receive Ozma's group at the universe's end; Ozma interrupts his sentence with rejection.
753:t_186:1: Gamlin gives a short mocking laugh at Advent's attempt to unsettle him about unrequited love.
753:t_187:8: Veffidas' emphatic agreement before Sivil asks Basara to sing has no words in the source.
753:t_187:10: Basara's 'Yeah!' is a standalone affirmative shout answering Sivil.
753:t_188:12 and753:t_188:13: Ledo's 'I'll prove' deliberately leaves its object to the next row, which supplies the clause about humans living without gods.
753:t_187:11: Basara addresses the universe, Advent and everything as a shouted invocation before his imperative to listen to his song.
uncertain: 753:t_183:3: Klan uses the exact source term Zentran; the gendered Meltran label is not substituted.
